items.headline: O: data-center electricity commitments
items.summary: O publicly pledged to support a national effort to provide “affordable, reliable electricity” for communities near its data centers, reflecting an operational and regulatory posture for capacity buildouts.

items.headline: O: acquire Pierre to expand Codex Git workflows
items.summary: O announced it will acquire Pierre Computer, citing Codex usage of Pierre’s Trees/Diffs libraries and aiming to adapt Git workflows for coding agents. Closing is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals.

items.headline: O: fundraising reportedly targets far-higher valuation ahead of IPO
items.summary: Reports cite O attempting to accelerate fundraising ahead of a potential IPO window, with investor discussions around a valuation far above prior marks; O reportedly declined to comment. This is valuation/funding-signal only.

items.headline: V: 2 in orbit; more launches planned
items.summary: V reportedly had two spacecraft operating in orbit, with an additional launch “in the coming days” and seven more next year, alongside scaling plans and hiring, supporting capacity ramp visibility.

items.headline: V: Australian authorization variation includes additional W-Series returns
items.summary: An Australian space-agency document indicates a variation to V’s return authorization to include additional W-Series capsule returns to Koonibba Test Range, supporting regulatory/operations continuity for reentry activity.

items.headline: V: Series D $251M to scale orbital pharma processing
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D (led by Lux Capital, Natural Capital) to scale in-space pharmaceutical processing, citing increased flight cadence and ongoing reentry/return capability.
